mentions.name: SiMMO
mentions.description: SiMMO is a browser-based reimplementation of The Sims Online MMO, porting both the original client and server from the game binary so the formerly desktop-only game runs in the browser.
mentions.problem: The original game ran on desktop and has been defunct for almost two decades.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The Sims Online MMO ported to the browser

The original ran on desktop and has been defunct for almost two decades, SiMMO reimplements both the client and server from the original game binary to run comfortably in your browser.
